subject: Renewal + 50% Capacity Add-on — Billing & PO details
messages:
From: Alice Dubois <alice.dubois@novaworks.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + 50% Capacity Add-on — Billing & PO details

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the renewal quote — we're ready to sign and add the 50% capacity top-up, but I need to confirm a few billing items before I route a PO to procurement.

1) We're switching billing ownership to Finance (procure@novaworks.com) effective this renewal. Please confirm the billing contact we should include on the PO and whether Redwood needs any entity-level details.
2) We plan to submit a formal PO next week — attaching a short intent doc to help speed things along (PO_Intent_NovaWorks.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood's legal payee name and the remit address for the PO?
3) We requested Net60 from our treasury team for this contract given quarter timing — is Redwood able to accept Net60 for the renewal? If not, what are escalation paths?
4) Finally, we operate in EU and will need to provide VAT evidence (TaxCert_EU.pdf) for the EU portion of spend — let me know which tax forms you require.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can get procurement moving.

Thanks,
Alice Dubois
Head of Finance Programs
NovaWorks

Attachments: PO_Intent_NovaWorks.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Dubois <alice.dubois@novaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + 50% Capacity Add-On — Billing & PO details

Alice — thanks and congrats on the expansion. Quick answers and next steps below.

- Legal payee: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Remit / invoice email: invoices@redwood.com
  Remit address (for PO mapping): 880 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102

- Billing contact on PO: procure@novaworks.com is fine; please ensure the PO references Deal ID DEAL-8734 and the SOW dated 2027-02-15 so it routes correctly.

- Net terms: Standard is Net30. Net60 is not standard but we can escalate — I will loop in Billing Ops to assess a one-time Net60 exception for this renewal. If Treasury requires Net60 as a hard condition, please flag that in the PO and we will run finance approval flow (timeline ~3 business days).

- Tax docs: For US payers we need a W-9 (if NovaWorks is US entity) or a VAT registration/Tax certificate for EU entities. If you already have TaxCert_EU.pdf, please include it with the PO and our team will validate.

Next actions:
1) Alice: please submit the formal PO to procure@novaworks.com --> invoices@redwood.com (cc me) with the entity name as above.
2) I'll open a formal billing ticket and include Marissa (your AM) and Billing Ops to scope Net60.
3) If you prefer a signed order form, I can send the DocuSign envelope after we confirm terms.

I'll follow up shortly with Jordan from Billing Ops.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Procure Team <procure@novaworks.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Dubois <alice.dubois@novaworks.com>, finance@novaworks.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: NovaWorks PO 8734 (intent -> formal PO)

Soojin,

Attaching our formal PO for the renewal and capacity top-up (NovaWorks_PO_8734.pdf). A few notes from procurement/finance:
- Billing contact: procure@novaworks.com (please ensure invoices and remittance details are set to this address).
- Net terms: Treasury is requesting Net60 for this renewal and wants it applied to the first invoice. They have provided TaxCert_EU.pdf for the EU entity.
- PO line items reference SOW 2027-02-15 and call out a 50% capacity addendum.

Please confirm receipt and whether Redwood requires any additional paperwork (W-9 / invoice template / remit instructions).

Regards,
NovaWorks Procurement

Attachments: NovaWorks_PO_8734.pdf; TaxCert_EU.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Procure Team <procure@novaworks.com>, Alice Dubois <alice.dubois@novaworks.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaWorks PO 8734 (intent -> formal PO)

Thanks for the PO and the tax cert — received. Looping in Jordan (Billing Ops) and Marissa (AM) to execute. Summary of what we need to finalize:

1) W-9 / Tax paperwork: For Redwood to accept the PO against our system, we need either: a) NovaWorks W-9 (if US entity) OR b) a validated EU VAT certificate plus confirmation of the invoicing entity to which the EU invoices should be sent. You included TaxCert_EU.pdf — Jordan, can you confirm what else is required to validate?
2) PO matching: Please ensure the PO PDF references Redwood Inference, Inc. exactly and includes DEAL-8734 and SOW date. If NovaWorks needs a separate purchase order number on invoices, please confirm how that should appear (PO# 8734?).
3) Net60 request: We can accommodate a one-time Net60 for the first invoice pending finance approval; finance typically requires the invoice split or a short payment plan for extended terms. Jordan/Jordan's team — please advise on acceptable splits (example: 50% upfront, remainder due Net30 after invoice).
4) Signed order form: To avoid delays in invoice scheduling, we recommend signing the order form via DocuSign. I've attached our standard order form for the renewal as a stub: OrderForm_Redwood_2027-03-02.pdf. If you sign the DocuSign envelope (link below) we will finalize the billing milestone dates.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D4E5F

Alice / Procure — please reply with: preferred PO# appearance on invoice, confirmation of remit email (procure@novaworks.com), and whether the PO timeline needs the Net60 guardrails as a mandatory clause.

Thanks,
Soojin

Attachments: OrderForm_Redwood_2027-03-02.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, Procure Team <procure@novaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Dubois <alice.dubois@novaworks.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaWorks PO 8734 (intent -> formal PO)

Thanks — billing ops reviewed the PO and tax cert. Quick summary and next steps from our side:

- Tax cert: TaxCert_EU.pdf is sufficient for EU validation; if NovaWorks also has a US entity for the same contract, please provide the W-9 for that entity so we can map invoices correctly.
- Net60: Finance approved a single Net60 concession for the first renewal invoice only, contingent on a 50%/50% split: 50% of the total due on issuance of first invoice (Net0), remaining 50% due Net30 after invoice. This was the compromise to limit receivable exposure.
- PO mapping: We will accept PO# 8734 on the invoice. Please ensure the PO includes Redwood Inference, Inc. as the payee and references DEAL-8734 and SOW 2027-02-15.
- Remit: invoices@redwood.com is our canonical remit mailbox. For automated remittance, you can also send confirmation to billing-ops@redwood.com.

Once you confirm the split and send the signed DocuSign envelope, we will queue the invoice for issuance and mark Net60 only on the second half. If NovaWorks prefers a different split, let us know and we'll run a quick finance review.

Jordan Blake
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
